data.name: Martial Law: Our Spring
data.detailed_description:
Martial Law: Our Spring is the second game in the Martial Law series. In this part of the adventure game, Stanislaw tries to put his life back together and stop mentioning his former wife everywhere. He found a new job, found a new love, and finally fixed the sink.

The new part of the game modifies some gameplay elements of the previous part: more freedom (but not too much free, martial law), a larger map, a bigger and better storyline, less bottomless dialogues, more Militiamen who can beat you up.

Key features

  • A top-down 2D pixel art adventure game
  • Almost open world
  • Janina's cat back
  • Learn more about polish culture from the communist era
  • Comrade for debating survived the winter
  • Make right choices, or don’t. It’s up to you.
  • 2 + 2 = 4



Co-financed by the Minister of Culture and National Heritage as part of the Center for the Development of Creative Industries' own program: Program Wsparcia Gier Wideo.
